svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat, 100 x 130 x 3 mm, in ASA in an enclosed printer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 holes, 80 apart across and 110 apart up and down, 10 in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the top and bottom edges: they meet the box's four moulded

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bosses. Measure your box's bosses first and move the holes to suit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out on the front: boost module upper left, ADC and shunt upper

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right, regulator and surge board below it, terminal strip along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom (left and right as seen from the lid side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each module's holes through the module; drill 3.2 for M3

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M4 screws into the bosses; the plate stands 6 mm off the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back wall and 12 mm above the floor, clear of the entry nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 0.5 mm; drops in and lifts out without force.
